reuse.why: All six month-wide actions use one new getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions helper and the existing setBudget/getSheetValue/isTrackingBudget/batchMessages machinery.

duplication.why: The exclusion rule is defined once; what repeats is the small 'load v_categories, check income, check skipped set' loop scaffold in each action, which was already per-action.

placement.why: The selection helper lives in budget/actions.ts beside getBudgetData, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Focused on the four requested behaviours; release notes are conventional for the repo.

maintainability.why: A new exclusion is a one-line change in a single named helper; minor cost of an extra full-table query per action and the income rule still checked at each site.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Every month-wide action (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, set3/6/12MonthAvg, setLastMonthSpending) consults the shared skip set.

disguised_duplication.where: The hidden/template/#fixed rules exist only in getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions; the old per-action SQL filters were removed.

abstraction_drift.where: getCategoryIdsSkippedByMonthWideActions in budget/actions.ts gained only the requested includeHiddenCategories parameter; the #fixed rule was added as one more condition of the same rule, and all call sites use it.
